variant_0_reference.name: Full Deployed Stage 2 Reference
variant_0_reference.description: 50-step Adam model-guided optimization (model loss + pareto penalty + dietary-change penalty + barrier penalty) + post-Adam clamping + joint convex quadratic projection + downstream filter audits + closed-loop model-score acceptance gate.

variant_1_no_model_objective.name: Ablate Model-Score Optimization Objective
variant_1_no_model_objective.description: Sets model risk loss terms (2.0*p_cvd + 2.0*p_diab + 1.0*p_obes) and Pareto penalty (50.0*ReLU(p - p0)) to 0.0 in Adam. Adam minimizes 0.001*||delta_N||^2 + barrier(N, lower, upper) without risk guidance, followed by the identical joint projection.

variant_2_no_change_penalty.name: Ablate Dietary-Change Penalty in Adam
variant_2_no_change_penalty.description: Sets the 0.001*||delta_N||^2 regularization weight to 0.0 in Adam loss. Optimizes purely for model risk reduction and barrier penalty without penalizing distance from observed intake.

variant_3_no_barrier_penalty.name: Ablate Differentiable Barrier Penalty in Adam
variant_3_no_barrier_penalty.description: Sets the barrier penalty to 0.0 in Adam loss. Relies purely on post-Adam hard box clamping (torch.clamp) and downstream joint projection to enforce bounds.

variant_4_no_joint_projection.name: Ablate Joint Constraint Projection
variant_4_no_joint_projection.description: Bypasses the convex quadratic joint projection onto the feasible polytope. Post-Adam clamped candidate (n_adam_clipped) is evaluated directly by downstream filters and the external validator. Directly quantifies joint numerical feasibility of unprojected Adam outputs.

variant_5_no_sequential_filters.name: Ablate Sequential Downstream Filters 1-3
variant_5_no_sequential_filters.description: Retains full Adam optimization and joint projection, but bypasses sequential execution of Filter 1, Filter 2, and Filter 3 prior to closed-loop rescoring. Verifies the code-path finding that sequential filters are mathematically redundant when preceded by joint projection.
